Package com.rocket.radar.eventmanagement

Class EventLotteryViewModel

java.lang.Object
androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
com.rocket.radar.eventmanagement.EventLotteryViewModel
public class EventLotteryViewModel extends androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
ViewModel for the Event Lottery section of event creation. Manages lottery-related data including waitlist capacity, event capacity, event date/time information, and registration deadlines. This ViewModel is scoped to the activity to preserve state across fragment replacements.
